about: How an Appendix B is read, as one list of cases: every JSON block fenced as ```json between the heading `## Appendix B` and the first `*End of PACT` after it; both markers there, every fence closed, every block JSON. A case answers `blocks`, or is `refused` in exactly these words. Two repositories keep byte-identical copies of this file. pact-identity's is js/appendix-b-reader.json, and its four readers are held to it by their tests: js/seed.mjs appendixB (js/seed.test.mjs), the pact CLI's appendix_b (crates/pact/src/vectors/check.rs), the core tests' appendix_b (crates/pact-identity/tests/vectors.rs) and the Go port's appendixB (go/vectors_test.go). pact-protocol's is vectors/appendix-b-reader.json, and vectors/check.mjs holds to it the one reader its checker and its splicer share (vectors/lib/appendix.mjs). No test holds the two copies to each other yet: pact-identity's gate reads pact-protocol's main branch, which gains its copy with pact-protocol PR #10.
